core.title: Core
core.description: VESTIGIAL / metadata only. Records whether this perfect sample anchors a 'core' cluster. Historically drove desk assignment; it no longer drives desk assignment, merge blocking, model features, or sampling. Desks and representative handles those now. Do not add behavior that depends on core.

representative.title: Representative
representative.description: ACTIVE. Controls Ward-clustering merge blocking (ranker/agglo.js wardCut). Representative perfect samples block merges with each other (two representatives cannot share a cluster under stop/constrained modes, or the legacy deskless fallback). This enforces 'representative samples cannot be merged'.

desk.title: Desk
desk.description: ACTIVE. Prevents desks from merging. Cross-desk merges are skipped (clustering continues); same-desk merges are allowed. Clusters never mix desks.
